blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-10-19. USDGLO has seven native deployments. It is directly freezable on two independent surfaces. On Stellar, issuer account GBBS25EGYQPGEZCGCFBKG4OAGFXU6DSOQBGTHELLJT3HZXZJ34HWS6XV holds flags auth_revocable=true, auth_clawback_enabled=true and auth_immutable=false (Horizon, last modified ledger 65016349, 2026-10-18T23:52:08Z), so the issuer can revoke a holder's trustline authorization or claw back its balance; Stellar carries 29.45% of supply. On the EVM deployments (Ethereum 17.36%, Celo 16.20%, Base 10.64%) the GloDollarV3 proxies at 0x4f604735c1cf31399c6e711d5962b2b3e0225ad3 expose DENYLISTER_ROLE: denylist(address), undenylist(address) and destroyDenylistedFunds(address), enforced on every transfer through _requireBalanceIsNotDenylisted. That role is held by the Brale operator EOA 0xb180f98037a63a3dca66b6b4ddbf250265b65110 on Ethereum, Celo and Base, which also holds PAUSER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE; paused() is false and the proxy is UUPS-upgradeable (Ethereum implementation 0xf8dbe4f52b7d4fe90cd360aa4f49b7a66783c56f). Named holders can therefore be denylisted and their balances destroyed today. Sub-threshold deployments: OP Mainnet 9.90%, Arbitrum 8.13%, Polygon 7.17%, VeChain 1.15%. No parent: variantOf and mintAuthority.inheritedFrom are null.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDGLO retains seven reviewed native-issuance routes: six EVM GloDollarV3 proxies and a native Stellar asset. Glo's dated November 18, 2025 notice states VeChain support ended January 1, 2026, although the address directory still lists 0x29c630cce4ddb23900f5fe66ab55e488c15b9f5e. This retirement disclosure supersedes the old unsupported-canonical-chain rationale, but proves neither zero residual liabilities nor complete transfer/control census. Brale documents issuer-native cross-chain burn/mint swaps, not USDGLO-specific LayerZero validation. Across remains a generic framework reference, not a reviewed USDGLO representation. Retirement status and conflicting directory evidence were observed 2026-10-10T23:44:47Z; existing route/control observations are not renewed.
